# Hartwell Pharmacy - September refill log

One row per dispensed refill. patient_code identifies the patient; when
the nightly export job retried, some refills were written to the file
more than once.

Front notes
- Cold chain bag goes back to the fridge at noon.
- The delivery driver signs the grey ledger.
